placements.why: Establishes the organizational strategy stratum for data platforms, database technologies, and pipeline architecture choices.
placements.title: Data Platform and Storage Infrastructure
placements.frame: How does the organization design, evaluate, and evolve its database systems and analytics infrastructure to meet scale and cost requirements?

placements.title: Migrating analytical pipelines from general-purpose relational databases to specialized high-performance query engines
placements.frame: What performance multipliers, licensing economics, and target milestones justify migrating analytical pipelines to dedicated database engines?
placements.why: Dave Quantum asserts a strategic decision to transition the analytics pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB, justified by 10x query performance, lower licensing costs, and a target delivery of Q3 2026.
